baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated كَادِحٌ ... كَدْحًا is given a vector by إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ and a culmination by فَمُلَاقِيهِ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Hardship-laden work is not random expenditure: lordship gives it direction, and face-to-face meeting gives it an unavoidable terminus.

activation_trace.role: Striving work with hardship supplies the sustained motion of the mechanism.
Ownership and authority make the direction relational and answerable rather than merely spatial.
Two parties coming face to face turns the endpoint into confrontation and presence.

changed_reading.before: A human works hard through life and eventually arrives at an endpoint.
changed_reading.after: Every human exertion already travels within a relation of lordship and must culminate in face-to-face encounter.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The cognate repetition of ك د ح can name both the doing and its accumulated result, while the final object pronoun can remain live beside the nearer كَدْحًا.
baseline_models.mechanism: Toil leaves a scratch or mar rather than vanishing as spent energy; the final meeting can therefore carry a coexisting reading in which the human encounters the very trace or outcome produced by the toil.

activation_trace.role: A scratch or bite-mark supplies the durable residue left by exertion.
Marring a face extends the residue from neutral effort to a biography that alters appearance.
What befalls a person as good or ill lets the accumulated result return as something encountered.

changed_reading.before: The human meets the Lord only after the toil is over.
changed_reading.after: Alongside meeting the Lord, the human meets the toil itself as a preserved scar, product, or consequence.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ can activate both the dominant repair-and-nurture inventory and the packet's non-dominant ر ب و mapping of increase and growth.
baseline_models.mechanism: The arduous motion is formative: it is movement toward the one who owns and completes, with an exploratory overtone of being raised or grown through the exertion rather than merely exhausted by it.

activation_trace.role: Persistent arduous work supplies the pressure under which formation occurs.
Repair, nurture, and completion make the destination an active formative relation.
The split mapping's increase and rising image supplies the exploratory ascent overtone.
Nourishment and growing up make increase developmental rather than merely quantitative.

changed_reading.before: Toil is a burden endured on the way to judgment.
changed_reading.after: Toil may also be the difficult medium by which the human is raised, repaired, and brought to completion.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The address ٱلْإِنسَانُ and the face-to-face force of مُلَاقِيهِ frame the worker as both perceiving presence and eventual object of encounter.
baseline_models.mechanism: The human is not only a laboring species but a visible, sensing presence. Toil carries that perceiver toward reciprocal exposure, where the one who notices the world must also stand noticed.

activation_trace.role: Visible human presence supplies the exposed subject of the address.
Perception by sight, sound, or feeling makes awareness part of what defines the addressed human.
Face-to-face convergence converts perception into reciprocal exposure.

changed_reading.before: Human is a generic species label for the one who labors.
changed_reading.after: Human names a visible perceiver whose labor ends in being brought fully into view before another.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening cosmic fissure scales up the scratch-image latent in ك د ح: the human bears small ruptures while the enclosing order bears a vast one. Personal toil and cosmic transition become differently scaled inscriptions of passage.

activation_trace.role: The mark left by scratching supplies the human-scale rupture.
Splitting and opening supply the world-scale rupture that mirrors the toil-mark.
Hardship and strain connect the fissure materially to arduous striving.

structural_cues: The window opens with a world-scale rupture before narrowing to the directly addressed human in 84:6.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a cosmic opening, human toil, and scratch-like residue; I supply the scale analogy that treats them as macro- and micro-ruptures. They may instead be sequential contrasts with no shared material mechanism.

changed_reading.after: Kadh is the human-scale scoring of the same passage that the surrounding world displays as fissure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sky and earth accept what is heard from their Lord and are bound to do so. Their repeated response changes the human's movement toward رَبِّكَ from neutral destination into an answer worked out under a rightful claim.

activation_trace.role: Arduous work becomes the human mode of answering.
Lordship supplies the relation under which the answer is due.
Attentive hearing and acceptance supply the responsive posture.
The same lordship relation links cosmic response to the human vector.
Fixed obligation makes the response rightful and unavoidable.

structural_cues: The paired أَذِنَتْ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتْ clauses in 84:2 and 84:5 surround the sky-and-earth transformations immediately before the human address.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated cosmic acceptance, obligation, and the shared Lord relation; I infer that human kadh is an analogous embodied answer. A live alternative is contrast: creation answers readily while the human merely arrives through resistant toil.

changed_reading.before: The human happens to move toward a sovereign endpoint.
changed_reading.after: The human's whole exertion is a prolonged answer to a claim already obeyed by the surrounding order.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earth is pulled out, casts what it held, and becomes empty. This gives the encountered-toil baseline a disclosure mechanism: extension opens the container, its contents are cast into encounter, and concealed accumulation is cleared from within.

activation_trace.role: The lasting mark supplies what the human has accumulated through exertion.
What one encounters of good or ill lets the exposed accumulation meet its maker.
Drawing something out lengthwise supplies the opening and exposure motion.
Casting a thing where it will be met supplies the transfer from hidden interior to confrontation.
An emptied place supplies the state left after contents are disclosed.
Release from liability adds an accountability overtone to the emptied interior.

structural_cues: 84:3-4 gives a container-to-exposure sequence immediately before 84:6, and the same ل ق ي root links casting there to meeting here.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies extension, casting, emptied interior, and the repeated meeting root; I map the earth's disclosure sequence onto the human's accumulated kadh. The alternative is that only the earth has contents and the shared root marks different actions without analogy.

changed_reading.before: The human simply reaches the end of a journey.
changed_reading.after: The journey ends by opening a container and casting out the accumulated trace so that the human encounters what had been carried within.

context_deltas.mechanism: The post-focus book joins separate acts into a written whole and fixes a binding determination; حساب then enumerates it. Kadh is therefore not an atmospheric burden but material that can be compiled, counted, and handed back for encounter.

activation_trace.role: Persistent work supplies the stream of acts available for compilation.
Durable marks explain how spent acts remain legible.
Encountered good or ill lets the compiled work return as consequence.
Joining one thing to another supplies the compilation of discrete exertions.
A written fixing that obligates judgment makes the compilation consequential.
Counting and accounting make the preserved work inspectable as a total.

structural_cues: Book-receipt follows 84:6 immediately, then divides into right-hand and behind-the-back orientations around an explicit accounting.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies arduous acts, joining into a book, binding inscription, and counting; I infer that the book is the operational form in which kadh becomes encounterable. It may instead record deeds without exhausting the broader referent of kadh.

changed_reading.before: Toil disappears into the past as it is performed.
changed_reading.after: Toil is continuously made legible, joined into a whole, and returned to the worker as an accountable encounter.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus human carries a latent capacity for familiarity and relief from estrangement. Later, joy among one's people occurs on both sides of the outcome, but only one configuration includes a sound return; domestic familiarity can therefore be restored after encounter or become the enclosure that nourishes denial of return.

activation_trace.role: Comforting familiarity supplies the social need carried by the addressed human.
Face-to-face meeting supplies the event that sorts rather than simply abolishes familiarity.
Returning and arriving back supply the successful homeward movement.
Nearness and belonging supply the relational destination of that return.
Hidden joy and ease supply the comfort that can either follow truth or conceal it.
Return and decrease expose the denied movement that domestic ease had obscured.

structural_cues: 84:9 and 84:13 repeat the family-and-joy configuration on opposite sides of the outcome, while 84:14 names the denied return.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies human familiarity, two family-joy scenes, one explicit return, and one denial of return; I infer that the encounter sorts forms of belonging. A live alternative is that the repeated social scene contrasts outcomes without redefining ٱلْإِنسَانُ.

changed_reading.before: The addressed human is an isolated worker leaving ordinary attachments behind.
changed_reading.after: The human is a familiarity-seeking social being whose attachments are tested and differently restored by the Lordward return.

context_deltas.mechanism: Return in 84:14 and the Lord's already-operative inward sight in 84:15 change meeting from a first contact into disclosure of a relation that accompanied the toil all along. The worker arrives before one who was never absent from the work.

activation_trace.role: Staying and enduring supply continuity to the Lord relation during the whole journey.
Face-to-face meeting supplies the final disclosure of that continuous relation.
Returning changes the trajectory from a first approach into a coming back.
The repeated enduring Lord relation links the return to an already-present destination.
Inward discernment supplies continuous knowledge of the worker before the meeting.

structural_cues: The denial of return in 84:14 is immediately overturned by the statement that his Lord had always been seeing him in 84:15.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies return, enduring lordship, and prior sight; I infer temporal continuity from sight to meeting. The alternative is that sight grounds judgment while meeting remains a distinct first face-to-face event.

changed_reading.before: The human travels toward a distant Lord and first enters His presence at the end.
changed_reading.after: The human returns into manifest presence before the Lord whose gaze and relation had held every stage of the toil already.

context_deltas.mechanism: Twilight yields to gathering night, the moon gathers into completeness, and the human rides state after state. The vector in 84:6 is therefore not a featureless straight line: phases carry, cover, and gather one another until their edges converge in meeting.

activation_trace.role: Persistent exertion supplies continuity through changing phases.
Making two sides meet supplies convergence as the architecture of the endpoint.
Twilight redness supplies a visible threshold between states.
Gathering dispersed things supplies accumulation within a phase.
Completion and coherence supply the moment when a gathered phase becomes whole.
One thing mounted over another supplies the carrying stack of successive states.
State after state makes transition itself the form of the journey.

structural_cues: The oath sequence moves through twilight, gathering night, full moon, and then the doubled طَبَقًا عَن طَبَقٍ construction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies successive thresholds, gathering, completion, mounting, and states; I infer that this sequence models the internal shape of kadh. It may instead certify resurrection by analogy while leaving the toil's path conceptually linear.

changed_reading.before: The human advances along one continuous line toward an endpoint.
changed_reading.after: The human is carried through nested states whose gathered residues converge at the meeting.

context_deltas.mechanism: The addressed perceiver later covers and blocks the truth. Against the scratch-image of kadh, that covering becomes unstable: denial may hide the reading of one's life, but it cannot remove the marks the life has made.

activation_trace.role: Perceptive awareness supplies the capacity that denial suppresses rather than lacks.
A durable scratch supplies evidence that remains under attempted concealment.
Covering supplies the material action of attempted concealment.
Blocking truth specifies what the covering tries to keep from recognition.

structural_cues: Refusal to believe and bow after recitation in 84:20-21 is followed by explicit covering and denial in 84:22.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies perception, scratch-marks, and truth-covering; I infer that marks function as resistant evidence beneath denial. The alternative is that ك ف ر remains a moral category with no material interaction with the kadh image.

changed_reading.before: Kadh records hardship but says nothing about self-deception.
changed_reading.after: Kadh inscribes a life so persistently that the perceiving human can cover its truth without actually erasing its testimony.

context_deltas.mechanism: What people gather inside is both held as meaning in the heart and enclosed like contents in a vessel, while already uncovered to knowledge. This internalizes the earth-container model: kadh accumulates within the human until what is inward becomes the object of encounter.

activation_trace.role: The lasting trace supplies what repeated exertion deposits.
Casting something before another supplies the eventual outward presentation of inward contents.
Encountered good or ill turns stored content into experienced consequence.
Disclosure to a knower means the hidden accumulation was never epistemically sealed.
Holding meaning in the heart supplies an inward moral container.
Putting a thing in a vessel makes accumulation materially inspectable.

structural_cues: The earth's contents in 84:4 and what humans contain in 84:23 form an outer-container and inner-container correspondence around the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inward holding, vessel containment, prior knowledge, and focus branches of trace and casting; I infer a deposit-to-disclosure arrow from kadh into meeting. A live alternative is that 84:23 concerns concealed intentions while the focus pronoun refers only to the Lord.

changed_reading.before: The toil is an outward course toward someone beyond the human.
changed_reading.after: The same course loads an inward vessel, and the final outward meeting exposes what the human has been carrying all along.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing sequence names intentional work, fitness against corruption, compensation imagined as straightening a crooked break, transformation, and extension without cutoff. It activates the Lord-as-repairer baseline: the endpoint need not merely display kadh's marring; it can fit, straighten, and transform what the toil has damaged without deleting its history.

activation_trace.role: Marring the face of a thing supplies the damage that calls for repair.
Repair, nurture, and completion supply the destination's restorative agency.
Encountered good or ill preserves consequence while allowing different resolutions.
Intentional action distinguishes directed work from mere fatigue.
Soundness against corruption supplies the reversal of marring.
Fitness for a thing makes repair a restoration of right relation.
Splinting a crooked break supplies the concrete restorative image for compensation.
Changing a form or replacing its condition supplies transformation rather than simple repayment.
The image of cutting an extension clarifies the negation as continuity without severance.

structural_cues: The final exception coordinates belief, intentional action, fitting deeds, compensation, negation, and non-severance in one closing movement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies work, soundness, fitting, splinting, changed form, and no cutoff; I infer that these form a repair sequence answering kadh's marring under the Lord's completion. They may instead be independent lexical facets of reward with no causal repair process.

changed_reading.before: Meeting merely reveals the intact record of whatever the toil produced.
changed_reading.after: For one live reading, meeting also admits a restorative transformation in which damaged work is fitted and straightened into an unsevered outcome.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it links a labor verb, visible skin, tidings, and pain as one somatic mechanism. It remains anchored in ٱلْإِنسَانُ, the packet's scratch-and-marring branches for ك د ح, and the later surface and pain branches. Downstream prose should mark it as a material analogy, not claim that بَشِّرْ lexically means skin in 84:24.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ٱلْإِنسَانُ is visibly embodied, and ك د ح can leave a scratch or mar a face before the final face-to-face encounter.

activation_trace.role: Visible human presence supplies the embodied surface on which a life can appear.
Scratch-marks supply the literal image of toil writing itself onto a body.
Facial marring turns the mark into altered public appearance.
The appearance of skin or surface activates somatic disclosure.
Pain makes the disclosed biography felt rather than merely seen.

changed_reading.before: Kadh is invisible moral effort known only through a later record.
changed_reading.after: Kadh can be imagined as a biography written into the human surface, made visible and painfully legible at encounter.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This optical reading is branch-distant because it activates the specialized 'human image in the pupil' inventory. It remains anchored in the focus noun ٱلْإِنسَانُ, face-to-face meeting, and the later Lordly sight. It should be rendered as an image of reciprocal visibility, never as the verse's lexical definition of human.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The packet permits ٱلْإِنسَانُ to evoke the small human image in an eye, while مُلَاقِيهِ brings two presences face to face.

activation_trace.role: The little human image in the pupil supplies the optical figure of a self held in another's gaze.
Face-to-face convergence makes seeing reciprocal rather than one-directional.
Actual sight supplies the gaze in which the human image becomes fully seen.

changed_reading.before: The human sees signs and later meets the Lord.
changed_reading.after: The meeting can be pictured as the perceiver discovering that the self had always stood as the seen image within the Lord's gaze.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is surprising because it uses a non-dominant split mapping of ر ب ب to activate rising and breath-swelling, then joins it to successive states. It remains packet-resolvable and anchored in إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ and arduous kadh. Downstream prose should identify it as a split-root bodily overtone, not as the primary morphology of رَبّ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Arduous كَدْحًا moves إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ, whose split inventory includes increase, rising, and swelling breath.

activation_trace.role: Striving with hardship supplies bodily exertion.
Increase and rising give the exertion an upward exploratory vector.
Panting or swelling breath embodies the cost of ascent.
Taking up and carrying an affair supplies active passage through difficulty.
State after state gives the embodied ascent successive rises.

changed_reading.before: The Lordward vector is abstract spiritual or judicial progress.
changed_reading.after: An exploratory bodily layer pictures it as panting ascent through successive states, with each rise enlarging and taxing the worker.

strongest_changes: Kadh became a durable deposit: first a scratch-like trace, then earth-like contents, a compiled account, and an inward vessel whose contents are encountered.
Meeting changed from first arrival before a distant Lord into return and disclosure before the gaze that had accompanied the toil throughout.
The path changed from a straight burden into layered gathering and, in one live reading, restorative transformation of what the burden had marred.
summary.what_was_special: The focus sustains several mechanisms without forcing a choice: meeting the Lord, meeting one's accumulated kadh, being formed through kadh, and becoming mutually visible. Context repeatedly converts motion into disclosure, but does so through cosmic, documentary, social, temporal, bodily, and reparative routes that should remain distinct.
remaining_uncertainties: The object pronoun in فَمُلَاقِيهِ remains productively open between the Lord and the toil or its outcome; context strengthens both readings without settling them.
The ascent and breath readings depend on the packet's non-dominant ر ب و mapping and therefore remain exploratory.
The earth-human container analogy, resistant-mark model, and repair sequence use reader-supplied causal arrows; their packet elements are firm, but the direction among them is abductive.
